Two safety details deserve the record: relationship canonicalization mirrors the dataset designer's own `resolveReferenceTo` (all four spellings), and the walk is GATED on `lookup`/`master_detail` so a plain field's segment can never be coerced into an object name and speculatively fetched. Multi-hop came free, is pinned, and is proven non-hypothetical (ADR-0071's picker builds 2-hop paths that reach this resolver today). Scope held exactly at "the label is in hand" per the card's own dedup reasoning. The reverse verification's one prediction deviation (the fetch-trace assertion moving with the walk while the result assertion held) is reported, not smoothed. #4263 (the table/pivot/metric early-return leaves dotted dimensions raw on those widgets — a real user-visible remainder) is correctly NOT ridden — enabling the client net there adds a resolution those widgets never had, a design call — and the seat is queueing it now.
